educationalGoal: To foster intelligence and originality, we will pick up philosophical thoughts and try to acquire reading comprehension and ability to think by oneself. Discussing philosophical thinking with others, students will understand others' thoughts, practice thinking with others, and develop critical thinking skills. Through these, students will cultivate the thinking ability necessary to become an autonomous engineers.
advice: Course Description: In each class, we read philosophical text and conduct a group scrutiny and discussion. After that, we make a summary and presentation. Then, lecturer gives lectures and conducts quizzes. Two philosophical essays should be submitted at #7 and #12. Themes are specified by students themselves. Expectations for Students: ・ In this course, emphasis is on accurate understanding of text, grasp of original way of thinking through it and application to each student's major. Be sure to work with that in mind. ・ Let's examine unknown term by oneself using various encyclopedias.
books: Discourse on the Method (Rene Descartes) (『方法序説』,デカルト,岩波書店,1997) 『デカルト「方法序説」を読む』,谷川多佳子,岩波書店,2014
requiredKnowledge: ・Make a habit of reading and acquire reading comprehension. ・Acquire writing skills through "Basic Style for Study A and B".

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand philosophical thinking and explain them concretely.
Be able to express themselves about the relation between technology and philosophy.
Be able to understand and express the ideas of others about the relation between technology and philosophy.
Be able to express the process and results of thinking about the relation between technology and philosophy.
Be able to think critically about the technology and philosophy and explain them in clear sentences.
Be able to self-evaluate target abilities for students in this course.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Understand philosophical thinking appropriately and explain them in your own words. 2. For technology and philosophy, express your thought process and its results in logical sentences. 3. Understand other people's ideas about technology and philosophy and express them in logical sentences. 4.About technology and philosophy, express the process and the results of thinking with others in logical sentences. 5.Think critically about technology and philosophy and explain them convincingly with clear sentences. 6. You can always evaluate whether you understand the class.
